text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Central Bank report says 1996 was a good year on the economic and financial levels.
- Professional Group of Moroccan Banks re-elects Othman Benjelloun as president.
- Interior Minister Driss Basri says measures are being considered to punish people using money to get votes during elections.
- European Commission to back Morocco's efforts to protect environment.
- Free trade zone near the northern city of Tangier is expected to accommodate 1,200 firms and create 60,000 jobs.
- Up to 46 percent of Moroccan firms say they are not ready to face the free trade zone with Europe.
- Up to 2,397 candidates in recent local council elections lodged appeals against results.
- The number of foreign tourists totalled 665,509 during the five first months this year against 626,317 the same period last year.
